system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: FILE-NWD-01 generated repeated network logon failures for svc-render at roughly one-minute intervals from 13:32 through 13:47 UTC. The records identify the same process ID and report status 0xc000006a, consistent with an incorrect password.

The domain controller recorded corresponding svc-render authentication failures, including NTLM status 0xc000006a and Kerberos pre-authentication status 0x18, with FILE-NWD-01 identified as the workstation or the same source address.

At 13:36 UTC, WS-NBLAKE-01 recorded a PowerShell process running as SYSTEM using explicit credentials for svc-render while targeting PROXY-NWD-01. This is not explained by the supplied inventory, which describes svc-render as the FILE-NWD-01 RenderQueue account.

The repeated FILE-NWD-01 failures are consistent with the supplied change-calendar scenario: svc-render was scheduled for password rotation at 13:30, and its job re-authenticates every minute. The available records do not establish whether the scheduled rotation or job update occurred.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-NWD-01 were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage, so the result or activity associated with the 13:36 credential use cannot be checked in those logs.
The supplied authentication records end at 13:47 UTC, so they do not show the remainder of the requested 13:20–14:20 UTC review window.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-render credential use from WS-NBLAKE-01 to PROXY-NWD-01 succeeded or resulted in any proxy access.
Who initiated the PowerShell activity on WS-NBLAKE-01, why it used svc-render, or whether it was authorized.
Whether the password rotation occurred, whether the RenderQueue job was updated, or whether any authentication succeeded later in the review window.
Whether the anomalous credential-use event was malicious rather than an undocumented administrative or operational action.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy authentication and access logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including records for svc-render and the source associated with WS-NBLAKE-01.
Collect WS-NBLAKE-01 PowerShell, process-creation, and logon-session evidence around 13:36 UTC to identify the command, parent process, and initiating user.
Verify the svc-render password-rotation and RenderQueue update records, including service/job configuration and operator activity.
Review authentication and endpoint telemetry through 14:20 UTC for any successful svc-render logons or related activity.
